description: Get the runtime policy gate settings (part of the runtime control plane). Response = { policy: { id, modelAllowlist, blockPii, blockSecrets, enforceMode, enabled, ... } | null }. The config the SDK's policyGate opt-in evaluates locally before each LLM call (exact-match model allowlist + blocking on PII / secret detection). Example phrasing: "what model restrictions are active right now?" / "is PII blocking enabled?"
name: get_policy_gate
